mapper.sql: SELECT u.user_id AS id, u.email, up.name, up.contact AS phone, u.role, CASE WHEN u.is_active = 1 THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'INACTIVE' END AS status, DATE(u.created_at) AS hire_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON u.user_id = up.user_id WHERE u.role = 'TRAINER'
mapper.select: ORDER BY u.created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE role = 'TRAINER'

SELECT u.user_id AS id, u.email, up.name, up.contact AS phone, u.role, CASE WHEN u.is_active = 1 THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'INACTIVE' END AS status, DATE(u.created_at) AS hire_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON u.user_id = up.user_id WHERE up.name = #{name} AND up.contact = #{phone} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET role = 'TRAINER' WHERE user_id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT gym_id FROM user_gym WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY joined_at ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE user_profiles SET name=#{name}, contact=#{phone} WHERE user_id=#{id}; UPDATE users SET email=#{email} WHERE user_id=#{id}
UPDATE users SET role = 'MEMBER' WHERE user_id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET is_active = CASE WHEN #{role} = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE user_id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_profiles WHERE trainer_id = #{appUserId}) AS assignedMembers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_feedback_requests cfr JOIN crm_users cu ON cu.id = cfr.trainer_id WHERE cu.app_user_id = #{appUserId} AND cfr.status IN ('pending','in_progress')) AS pendingFeedback, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_re_registration crr JOIN crm_users cu ON cu.id = crr.assigned_to WHERE cu.app_user_id = #{appUserId} AND crr.status = 'pending') AS pendingReregistration

SELECT u.user_id AS id, up.name, up.contact AS phone, up.tier, up.member_type, CASE WHEN u.is_active = 1 THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'SUSPENDED' END AS status FROM user_profiles up JOIN users u ON u.user_id = up.user_id WHERE up.trainer_id = #{appUserId} ORDER BY up.name ASC
